title: Orchestrator harness has a gateway but no usable model
description:
Found by the first live run that reached the skill loop (run_8fc70c9b...). The container booted, cloned at the submitted SHA, passed all three environment checks from the migrated runners.toml, and started the omp harness — then sat at "Working..." producing no further output until stopped.

Cause: cloud/sandbox/entrypoint.sh exports gateway base URLs and the run token for the vendor paths (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$gateway/anthropic, OPENAI_BASE_URL=$gateway/openai, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL=$gateway/openrouter) and sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY to the RUN GATEWAY TOKEN. But:
- TICKS_MODEL is empty (entrypoint.sh:48), so the harness is given no model to use.
- There is no workers-ai route exported at all, even though tk factory setup --provider workers-ai is the documented no-key rung.
- The run token authenticates to OUR worker; the worker still needs a real provider credential to forward upstream, and none is configured.

So the harness has a reachable gateway and nothing it can actually call. It does not fail — it hangs, which is worse than an error and is exactly the class of silence the green-start trap exists to catch.

Work:
1. Export a workers-ai route and select a model so the documented no-key rung actually works end to end, since that is the rung this deployment is configured for.
2. Set TICKS_MODEL from the role/tier routing rather than leaving it empty, so the orchestrator harness runs on a configured model like every other role does.
3. Make an unusable model configuration FAIL FAST with an actionable message at boot, not hang. Probe the gateway with a trivial completion before starting the harness — the same content-gate discipline tk herd spawn already applies to workers, for the same reason.
acceptance_criteria: A run on a workers-ai-configured factory reaches the skill loop AND makes a successful model call, evidenced in the streamed harness output; a factory with no usable model configuration fails at boot with an actionable message instead of hanging; the model the orchestrator uses comes from the role/tier routing.
